title: The Unexpected Treasure: A Girl’s Metal Detecting Adventure
style_guide: cinematic, photorealistic, 16:9 aspect ratio, consistent warm lighting and soft focus for emotional storytelling

scenes.narration: Thirteen-year-old Stacy loved metal detecting. She followed her grandfather's advice to explore the forest when the beach was closed.
scenes.visual: A young girl with a metal detector in hand, exploring a lush forest near a giant oak tree under soft natural light, with a sense of curiosity.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic, photorealistic scene of a young girl metal detecting in a dense forest, large oak tree in the background, warm sunlight filtering through leaves, 16:9 aspect ratio

scenes.narration: She uncovered a mysterious silver coin engraved with an unusual crest. Excited, she shared her find online.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Stacy holding an ancient-looking silver coin, captured in a reflective, detailed shot; her face shows excitement, computer screen glowing softly in the background.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic, photorealistic close-up of a silver coin with intricate crest held by a young girl, detailed textures, warm ambient lighting, 16:9 aspect ratio

scenes.narration: The next morning, police arrived. They explained the coin was stolen. Stacy learned a lesson about sharing discoveries responsibly.
scenes.visual: A scene showing police officers talking to Stacy and her mother outside their house, with police cars in the background; the mood is serious but calm.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic, photorealistic scene of police officers speaking with a family outside a suburban house at dawn, police cars parked, soft natural light, 16:9 aspect ratio
